questions.question: Which country launched drone attacks against a US military base in Bahrain?
questions.explanation: Iran launched drone strikes against a US military base in Bahrain.

questions.question: Why is Estonia closing all border crossings with Russia starting December 1?
options: Following a sabotage attack on a drone maker
questions.explanation: Estonia shut its border following a suspected sabotage attack on a domestic drone maker.

questions.question: Who won the U.S. Senate seat in Mississippi, becoming the first Black senator elected from the state since the 19th century?
questions.explanation: Democrat Scott Colom narrowly defeated Cindy Hyde-Smith to win the Mississippi Senate seat.

questions.question: What caused the nationwide ground stop that delayed thousands of flights across the United States?
options: An aging air traffic control system overloading
questions.explanation: Officials blamed an aging air control system overloading rather than a cyber-attack.

questions.question: Which tech giant was fined hundreds of millions of dollars by Italy's data regulator over user photo privacy?
questions.explanation: Italy's data protection regulator issued a massive fine against Meta.
